clippings.speaker: Christian Bale
clippings.quote: He represents the audience for us on the set.
clippings.title: Christian Bale THE DARK KNIGHT RISES Interview
clippings.context: Bale explaining, on the Dark Knight Rises shoot, why he values Nolan's sense of how the audience will react.

clippings.speaker: Christian Bale
clippings.quote: That's exactly the thing that I need, he's very firm with it.
clippings.title: Christian Bale THE DARK KNIGHT RISES Interview
clippings.context: Bale describing how Nolan answers his offers of alternative takes on a scene, in a 2012 interview about The Dark Knight Rises.

clippings.speaker: Christian Bale
clippings.quote: And if he wished to tell that story with me, I'd be in.
clippings.title: Christian Bale says he'd play Batman again—but only if Christopher Nolan is the director
clippings.context: Bale on whether he would return as Batman, saying he would only come back if Nolan had a story he wanted to tell with him.

clippings.speaker: Christopher Nolan
clippings.quote: He is the first to acknowledge the inherent ridiculousness of what an actor has to do sometimes.
clippings.title: 'We're Done': Christopher Nolan Says Ending 'Batman' Trilogy Was 'Emotional'
clippings.context: Nolan, at the close of the Batman trilogy in 2012, praising Bale for taking the work seriously without taking himself too seriously.

clippings.speaker: Christopher Nolan
clippings.quote: I think that what Christian figured out from the script, and what we were able to put into the story was that by the end of the film, I think he makes the film very much his own.
clippings.title: Christopher Nolan Interview
clippings.context: Nolan in a 2008 interview about The Dark Knight, saying Bale made the film his own by its end.

notes: Two Nolan quotes and the Bale quotes came through a summarizing fetch with a 125-character cap, so re-check wording on the live pages before publishing.
